points.description: Names the perpetual/terminal/long-term growth rate (growth rate of cash flows beyond the forecast period) as one of the two sensitivities.
Names WACC / discount rate / cost of capital as the other sensitivity.

rubric.notes: Award 1 mark for each of the two factors: growth rate (terminal/perpetual/long-term growth) and discount rate (WACC, cost of capital, required return), in any wording. Order does not matter. Give 0 for a factor not given; vague answers such as 'growth' alone may earn the mark for P1. Extra wrong remarks do not cost marks unless they contradict the answer.
